# Mandatory SRW instructions for GitHub Copilot and VS Code coding assistants

Before editing ANY source, tests, release metadata or docs, open /AGENTS.md and READ every document in its ordered onboarding list. In the first response, state SHA/version/schema, evidence boundaries and chosen acceptance-first tasks. Enforce docs/PRODUCT_CHARTER.md, docs/DEVELOPMENT_GOVERNANCE.md, docs/VERSION_POLICY.md, docs/DUAL_CARRIER_PLAN.md, ADR-0002 and docs/API_FIRST_MODULAR_CORE_ROADMAP.md. Never claim a product release from source/Chromium CI. Windows and local Browser are parallel thin carriers sharing a single C11 Core. Use the API-first modular-monolith order: operator outcome → Domain/Application → API contract → client; do not default new business rules into fullworkbench.py, frontend/dist/app.js or the WPF Host. No new UI framework, wholesale core rewrite, microservices/second database, multi-repo split or cloud SaaS. Use PR template + review + governance CI, and keep SOURCE_MANIFEST.sha256 accurate. Do not expose candidate data or keys.

IMPORTANT NOW: main has NO server-side branch protection at owner's request. Before editing read docs/NO_BRANCH_PROTECTION_PROTOCOL.md, create a task branch, run python scripts/agent_preflight.py --issue <issue> --acknowledge-reading; NEVER direct-push main or merge before current exact-HEAD checks pass. A direct push audit is retrospective only.
